male_path.title: The Scavenger's Choice
male_path.description: The wasteland stretches endlessly before you. Your last job went sideways, and now you're running low on everything that keeps you alive.

events.title: The Abandoned Settlement
events.description: You spot smoke rising from what looks like an abandoned settlement. Your scanner picks up movement - could be survivors, could be hostiles. Your water supply is running dangerously low.

choices.text: Approach cautiously, try to trade for supplies
Scout from a distance, look for an opportunity to scavenge
Avoid entirely, can't risk contact with anyone

events.title: The Consor Patrol
events.description: A Consor patrol drone hovers overhead. They haven't spotted you yet, but your augmented scanner is pinging - they're looking for someone. Could be you, could be someone else.

choices.text: Power down all tech and hide until they pass
Signal the patrol - maybe they have work
Hack their comm channel to see what they're hunting

events.title: The Radio Signal
events.description: Your radio crackles to life - a distress signal from someone claiming to be trapped in the old subway tunnels. They're offering payment for rescue, but the tunnels are Consor territory now.

choices.text: Negotiate payment upfront before risking your neck
Ignore the signal - too risky for unknown reward

female_path.title: The Garden's Shadow
female_path.description: The dome's gardens have always been your sanctuary, but today something feels different. The air recyclers sound strained, and the Council seems on edge.

events.title: The Wilting Section
events.description: You discover a section of the food gardens showing signs of blight. The automated systems haven't detected it yet, but if it spreads, it could threaten the dome's food security.

choices.text: Report it immediately to the Council
Try to treat it yourself with garden supplies
Keep quiet and observe - learn what's really happening

events.title: The Stranger's Message
events.description: A maintenance worker you've never seen before slips you a note while you're tending the orchards. It contains coordinates to a location outside the dome and a warning about 'what they're not telling you.'

choices.text: Turn the note over to dome security immediately
Confront the worker directly about the message
Keep the note hidden and investigate the coordinates

events.title: The Council's Secret
events.description: While delivering garden reports, you overhear a heated Council discussion about 'resource allocation' and 'acceptable losses.' They mention sending someone outside the dome - something that hasn't happened in years.

choices.text: Volunteer to go outside - you want to help
Ask questions about what's really happening
Pretend you heard nothing and leave quietly
